skill.name: claude-opus-4-5-migration
skill.description: Migrates Claude Sonnet 4.0, Sonnet 4.5, and Opus 4.1 projects to Opus 4.5. Updates model strings, beta header guidance, effort settings, and targeted prompt adjustments. It does not migrate Haiku 4.5.
skill.summary: Guides focused upgrades from Claude Sonnet 4.0, Sonnet 4.5, or Opus 4.1 to Opus 4.5.
skill.author: davila7

content.value_statement: Teams upgrading Claude apps must update model identifiers, beta headers, effort settings, and prompts without changing unrelated behavior. This skill guides a focused migration to Opus 4.5 across API providers and prompt patterns.
actual_capabilities: Finds Claude Sonnet 4.0, Sonnet 4.5, and Opus 4.1 model strings.
Provides replacement model identifiers for Anthropic API, Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Azure AI Foundry.
Removes the unsupported 1M context beta header for Opus 4.5 migrations.
Adds high effort guidance when the user requests effort configuration.
Suggests targeted prompt adjustments for tool use, code exploration, frontend design, and thinking wording.
Keeps Haiku 4.5 migrations out of scope.
limitations: It does not migrate Haiku models.
It depends on current Opus 4.5 model identifiers in the skill files.
It does not verify provider account access or deployment availability.
Prompt snippets should be applied only when the user reports the matching issue.

use_cases.title: Upgrade API Clients
use_cases.description: Update model names and unsupported beta headers in application code that calls Claude APIs.

use_cases.title: Tune Migration Prompts
use_cases.description: Adjust existing system prompts when Opus 4.5 changes tool use, exploration, or design behavior.

use_cases.title: Review Provider Mappings
use_cases.description: Compare Anthropic, Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Azure model identifiers before release planning.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Model Upgrade
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner migration for a small app.
prompt_templates.prompt: Migrate this project from Claude Sonnet 4.5 to Opus 4.5. Update only the required model strings and summarize the changes.

prompt_templates.title: Provider-Aware Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the Claude API calls in this repository. Replace supported source model identifiers with the correct Opus 4.5 identifiers for each provider.

prompt_templates.title: Prompt Behavior Adjustment
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced migration after behavior changes appear.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these system prompts for Opus 4.5. Apply only the prompt adjustments that match the specific behavior problems I describe.

prompt_templates.title: Full Release Readiness Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Claude migration for model strings, unsupported beta headers, effort settings, and prompt changes. Report remaining risks and manual checks.

output_examples.input: Migrate a Sonnet 4.5 Anthropic API integration to Opus 4.5.
output: The model identifier was updated to the Opus 4.5 Anthropic API target.
No Haiku model references were changed.
The migration summary lists the changed files and remaining manual checks.

output_examples.input: Update prompts because Opus 4.5 calls tools too often.
output: Aggressive tool-triggering language was softened only where it controlled tool use.
Unrelated emphasis and product copy were left unchanged.
The result explains why each prompt edit was made.

output_examples.input: Check whether a Bedrock migration is ready for Opus 4.5.
output: The provider-specific model identifier was checked against the skill reference.
Unsupported beta header usage was reviewed.
Effort configuration was flagged as an optional follow-up when requested.

best_practices: Search the repository before changing model identifiers or prompt text.
Apply prompt snippets only when the user reports the matching behavior issue.
Summarize every model, beta header, effort, and prompt change after migration.
anti_patterns: Do not migrate Haiku models with this skill.
Do not append every prompt snippet by default.
Do not change unrelated application logic during a model migration.

faq.question: Does this skill migrate Haiku 4.5?
faq.answer: No. The skill explicitly keeps Haiku models out of scope.

faq.question: Which source models does it target?
faq.answer: It targets Claude Sonnet 4.0, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Claude Opus 4.1 migrations to Opus 4.5.

faq.question: Does it support multiple cloud providers?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes model identifiers for Anthropic API, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Azure AI Foundry.

faq.question: Will it rewrite all prompts automatically?
faq.answer: No. Prompt adjustments should be applied only when the user reports a specific Opus 4.5 behavior issue.

faq.question: Does it change effort settings?
faq.answer: It includes guidance for high effort configuration when the user requests effort setup.

faq.question: Is it a code execution skill?
faq.answer: No. The skill is Markdown guidance for migration and does not include scripts or executable tooling.
